digest.component_or_area: code-review criterion framework / project extension surface
propositions: Author a project-owned criterion that detects when Pass-1 finder leaks severity, confidence, drop/block policy, or remediation instructions; Pass-2 verifier discovers new findings or prescribes fixes; Pass-3 decider applies non-deterministic logic; or Pass-4 coach re-adjudicates or dictates implementation.

Implement the criterion as a single-turn Pass-1 finder emitting grounded evidence only, with no severity/confidence fields and empty suggested_fix, routed with blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90.

Create a balanced 12-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire, RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) that validates phase-boundary violations and legitimate refinements, achieving recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, kappa≥0.70, and stability_min≥2/3 across three runs.
Record and attest a live three-run calibration with model, timestamp, all 36 case executions, and required metric targets on this ticket.
